svg.title: A single artificial neuron: inputs, weights, summation, activation, and output
svg.desc: Three inputs x1, x2, x3 enter from the left. Each is multiplied by a weight w1, w2, w3. A bias b also feeds into the summation node (sigma), computing z. The activation function phi(z) produces output a.
svg.text: z = w₁x₁ + w₂x₂ + w₃x₃ + ··· + b ← one number per input, summed with bias
a = φ(z) ← activation squashes z into the neuron's output
